user.title: Add a Neo Smart Blinds controller
user.description: Blinds are added after this, from the controller's entry: choose Add blind.

data_description.host: The controller's IP address. In the Neo app open the menu, choose Your Controllers, and read the IP line under the controller. Give it a fixed address in your router so it doesn't change.
data_description.protocol: HTTP is recommended: the controller reports a wrong controller ID or a bad command. TCP only echoes the command back.

data_description.port: Filled in with the default for {protocol}. Only change it if your controller uses a different port.
data_description.hub_id: In the Neo app open the menu, choose Your Controllers, and copy the long ID (about 24 characters) under the controller's name. Required for HTTP, not used by TCP.

reauth_confirm.title: Controller ID rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The controller at {host} rejected the controller ID. Enter the ID shown under the controller in the Neo app.

data_description.hub_id: In the Neo app open the menu, choose Your Controllers, and copy the long ID (about 24 characters) under the controller's name. Required for HTTP, not used by TCP.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller. Check the host, protocol and port.
error.hub_id_required: The controller ID is required for HTTP.

abort.blind_imported: The blind was added to an existing controller.
abort.invalid_protocol: Protocol must be http or tcp.
abort.invalid_blind_code: The blind code must use the format 000.000-00.
abort.invalid_parent_group: The parent group must use the format 000.000-15.

data_description.name: How the blind is named in Home Assistant, for example Kitchen left.
data_description.blind_code: In the Neo app open the blind, tap the settings (advanced) page and read Blind Code, for example 021.230-04. To control a whole room as one cover, use the Room Code (it ends in -15) instead.
data_description.motor_code: Shown as Motor code under the Blind Code on the same page of the Neo app. Pick it from the list, or type it if it's missing. Some controllers (such as the C-BR300) need it.
data_description.rail: For top-down/bottom-up blinds (the Neo app shows Top-D/Bottom-U: YES). Ordinary blinds use the top rail.
data_description.tdbu_extended: Only for top-down/bottom-up blinds whose motor code is mb, ra, ap or db. Leave off for tb motors and ordinary blinds.
data_description.percent_support: The controller never reports where a blind is, so Home Assistant estimates it from the close time. Choose mode 1 only if the % position switch works for this blind in the Neo app.
data_description.close_time: Seconds the blind takes to go from fully open to fully closed. Not shown in the Neo app: time it with a stopwatch.
data_description.start_position: Optional. The position (0 closed, 100 open) to assume when Home Assistant starts, in modes 1 and 2. Leave empty to restore the last known position.
data_description.parent_group: Optional. The Room Code from the blind's settings page in the Neo app (ends in -15). When every blind with the same room code gets the same command within 250 ms, one room command is sent instead.

error.invalid_motor_code: Motor codes are two letters or digits, for example bf.
error.tdbu_extended_motor: The extended command set only applies to motor codes mb, ra, ap and db.
error.parent_is_blind: The room code must differ from the blind code.
error.position_not_supported: Sending positions needs the top rail, the standard command set and a motor code of no, db, ra, rb, ap, bl, mb or jo. Use mode 2 instead.
error.already_configured: This blind and rail are already set up on this controller.

options.0: 0 - Favourites only: open, close, stop and favourites
options.1: 1 - Send position to the blind (motor must support positions)
options.2: 2 - Emulate position: move up or down, then stop after the calculated time

invalid_hub_id.message: The controller rejected the controller ID. Re-authenticate the integration with the correct ID.

position_not_enabled.message: Positioning mode 0 only accepts 50 (favourite 1) and 51 (favourite 2). Change the blind's positioning mode to use other positions.

yaml_import_failed.title: NeoSmartBlinds YAML blind could not be imported
yaml_import_failed.description: The blind {name} in configuration.yaml could not be imported ({reason}). Fix it in YAML and restart, or add it from the UI, then remove the YAML entry.
